description.value: Osaka Kitchen is a Japanese restaurant in Surrey's Guildford Village Shopping Centre serving sashimi, sushi, and noodle dishes made with fresh ingredients. It sits inside a large strip-mall complex on 104 Avenue, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the Guildford area. The menu covers a broad range of Japanese cuisine styles, and online ordering for takeout is available.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces) at 9m; rack (4 spaces) at 40m; rack (4 spaces) at 66m; rack (4 spaces) at 66m; rack (6 spaces) at 67m; rack (6 spaces) at 95m. Total: 28 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active Japanese restaurant (sushi, sashimi, noodles) at #108, 15637 104 Ave., Surrey, inside Guildford Village Shopping Centre, matching the OSM address and unit. The site explicitly advertises 'Order Online for Takeout / Pickup,' confirming takeout. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website lists two numbers — (604) 954-1074 and (604) 954-1099. Primary number used in output.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Japanese restaurant with a functioning website, confirmed address, and online ordering. A useful food stop for touring cyclists in the Guildford area.
